triggers.name: bot_command
triggers.title: New command
triggers.help: Define Workbot command. When this command is sent to Workbot by a %{provider.capitalize} user, it will carry out actions in this recipe. Use the Post reply action to send a response back to the %{provider.capitalize} user.

input.name: action_name
input.label: Command name
input.hint: Command name must be unique, one word, downcased, and contain no spaces.

input.name: friendly_name
input.label: Command hint
input.hint: Display this instead of command name in response to help messages. Can contain muliple words and spaces.

input.name: parameters
input.label: Parameters
input.hint: Define command input fields and get Workbot to request each value from the user.

input.name: hide_from_help
input.label: Hide command in 'help' messages
input.hint: If Yes , command will not show in help messages. Defaults to No .

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.description: Custom action in Workbot for Workplace (Custom)
actions.help: Build your own Workplace action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Workplace account. All string inputs should be in UTF-8 encoding.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: post_bot_attachment
actions.title: Post attachment
actions.help: Posts an attachment to Workplace user or channel by specifying an attachment URL. Optionally include quick reply buttons together with post.

input.name: recipient
input.label: Send message to
input.hint: Select user(s) who should receive this message. To dynamically set user(s), toggle to 'Enter custom value'.

input.name: type
input.label: Type
input.hint: Select attachment type.

input.name: body
input.label: File contents
input.hint: File contents can be obtained using action Download file from URL file in File tools by Workato

input.name: file_name
input.label: File name
input.hint: File name should be with file extension, e.g chart.png .
